title.sl: Odvisna vprašanja: he asked where I lived
title.de: Indirekte Fragen: he asked where I lived
title.it: Le domande indirette: he asked where I lived
title.en: Asking through someone: he asked where I lived

rule.sl:
Vprašanje z vprašalnico: **asked** + **where**, **when**, **what** … + besedni red trdilne povedi, brez do in did: »Where do you live?« → **He asked where I lived.** (Vprašal je, kje živim.) »Where is the inn?« → **She asked where the inn was.**

Da ali ne: **asked if** ali **asked whether**: »Do you want tea?« → **She asked if I wanted tea.** (Vprašala je, ali želim čaj.)

Čas gre korak nazaj kot pri said: **do → did**, **is → was**, **can → could**, **did → had**. Če je še res, tudi **He asked where I live.**

Vljudno v sedanjiku: **Do you know where the inn is?** **Could you tell me where the bus stops?** **I don't know if Jack is coming.**

Na Irskem, Škotskem in severu Anglije ljudje rečejo tudi *He asked did I want tea* in *He asked where did I live*, in pogosto se sliši *Do you know where is the inn?* Pisava želi **if** in besedni red trdilne povedi.

**asked me**, ne *asked to me*.
rule.de:
Frage mit Fragewort: **asked** + **where**, **when**, **what** … + die Wortstellung des Aussagesatzes, ohne do und did: „Where do you live?“ → **He asked where I lived.** (Er fragte, wo ich wohne.) „Where is the inn?“ → **She asked where the inn was.**

Ja oder nein: **asked if** oder **asked whether**: „Do you want tea?“ → **She asked if I wanted tea.** (Sie fragte, ob ich Tee wolle.)

Die Zeit geht einen Schritt zurück wie bei said: **do → did**, **is → was**, **can → could**, **did → had**. Wenn es noch stimmt, auch **He asked where I live.**

Höflich im Präsens: **Do you know where the inn is?** **Could you tell me where the bus stops?** **I don't know if Jack is coming.**

In Irland, Schottland und Nordengland sagt man auch *He asked did I want tea* und *He asked where did I live*, und oft hört man *Do you know where is the inn?* Die Schrift will **if** und die Wortstellung des Aussagesatzes.

**asked me**, nicht *asked to me*.
rule.it:
Domanda con parola interrogativa: **asked** + **where**, **when**, **what** … + l'ordine della frase affermativa, senza do e did: «Where do you live?» → **He asked where I lived.** (Ha chiesto dove abitavo.) «Where is the inn?» → **She asked where the inn was.**

Sì o no: **asked if** o **asked whether**: «Do you want tea?» → **She asked if I wanted tea.** (Ha chiesto se volevo del tè.)

Il tempo fa un passo indietro come con said: **do → did**, **is → was**, **can → could**, **did → had**. Se è ancora vero, anche **He asked where I live.**

Cortese al presente: **Do you know where the inn is?** **Could you tell me where the bus stops?** **I don't know if Jack is coming.**

In Irlanda, in Scozia e nel nord dell'Inghilterra si dice anche *He asked did I want tea* e *He asked where did I live*, e spesso si sente *Do you know where is the inn?* Lo scritto vuole **if** e l'ordine della frase affermativa.

**asked me**, non *asked to me*.
rule.en:
A question with a question word: **asked** + **where**, **when**, **what** … + a statement's word order, with no do or did: "Where do you live?" → **He asked where I lived.** "Where is the inn?" → **She asked where the inn was.**

Yes or no: **asked if** or **asked whether**: "Do you want tea?" → **She asked if I wanted tea.**

The tense goes one step back as with said: **do → did**, **is → was**, **can → could**, **did → had**. If it's still so, also **He asked where I live.**

Politely, in the present: **Do you know where the inn is?** **Could you tell me where the bus stops?** **I don't know if Jack is coming.**

In Ireland, Scotland and the North people also say *He asked did I want tea* and *He asked where did I live*, and you often hear *Do you know where is the inn?* Writing wants **if** and a statement's word order.

**asked me**, not *asked to me*.

tip.sl: 💡 Slovensko *ali* v odvisnem vprašanju je **if** ali **whether**: **She asked if I wanted tea.**
tip.de: 💡 *ob* ist **if** oder **whether**, nicht *that*; das Verb bleibt wie in der Aussage: **where I lived**.
tip.it: 💡 *se* in una domanda indiretta è **if** o **whether**; l'ordine è affermativo: **where I lived**.
tip.en: 💡 **where I lived**, a statement's order; yes or no takes **if**.
